in_sanskrit.name: Soyab
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Cool, Soybean
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Soyab एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Soyab is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shayana' which means 'to sit' and 'soya' which is the Hindi term for soybean. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and protection, representing the calming and nurturing qualities of the soybean plant. It is a unique and meaningful name for a baby boy.
